text:
```yaml
name: CockroachDB Testing

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  cockroachdb-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Add CockroachDB TestContainers dependency
        run: |
          echo "testcontainers-cockroachdb" >> pom.xml
          echo "<dependency>" >> pom.xml
          echo "  <groupId>org.testcontainers</groupId>" >> pom.xml
          echo "  <artifactId>cockroachdb</artifactId>" >> pom.xml
          echo "  <version>1.16.3</version>" >> pom.xml
          echo "</dependency>" >> pom.xml

      - name: Build project
        run: mvn clean install -DskipTests

      - name: Run CockroachDB tests
        run: mvn test -DenableCockroachDBTests=true

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: target/surefire-reports
```
